answer: The ridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the comet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the zenith of the next round.
